defects.cause: The renderer defaults missing public_read to True and does not enforce restricted classification.
defects.trigger: Deploy the supplied restricted customer-invoice bucket configuration, which omits public_read.
defects.consequence: The emitted policy grants anonymous reads to restricted invoice storage under the documented deployment adapter.
defects.boundary: Restricted customer data must not be exposed to anonymous readers by generated infrastructure policy.
defects.evidence: bucket.json selects restricted classification; the default emits read_principals=["*"].
defects.proof: oracle.py parses supplied JSON, proves the emitted public principal, rejects explicit restricted-public configuration in the control, and preserves explicit public assets.

limitations: The access grant is proven in the emitted policy only; no storage bucket is provisioned and no live data is accessed.
